name: clawd-for-meet
description: Chrome extension: Clawd, the Claude Code mascot, replaces you in Google Meet and talks with your mouth

scripts.zip: zip -r clawd-for-meet.zip manifest.json src popup detector vendor icons
scripts.vendor: cp node_modules/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/vision_bundle.mjs vendor/ && cp node_modules/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/wasm/vision_wasm_internal.* vendor/wasm/ && curl -sSfL -o vendor/face_landmarker.task https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task
